test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the following.

(sin³ α + cos³ α)/(sin α + cos α)
solution:
Given

(sin³ α + cos³ α)/(sin α + cos α)

Formula Used:

a³ + b³ = (a + b) (a² + b² - ab)

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Calculation:

(sin³ α + cos³ α)/(sin α + cos α) = [(sin α + cos α) (sin²α + cos²α - sinα cosα)]/(sin α + cos α)

⇒ 1 - sin α cos α

**The value is 1 - sin α cos α.**
